📝 Pastebin guide

Sorola Pastebin is a fast and simple way to share code, logs, or other text with temporary links. No registration required.

1. Type or paste text

Type or paste the text or code you want into the text field. You can optionally choose a programming language for syntax highlighting.

Note: It is safest to store the code for Bitwarden account two-step login separately from the same vault that requires the code to open. Also keep the recovery code safe. Do not paste passwords, API keys or other sensitive data into Pastebin — paste links are public and anyone with the link can read the content.

2. Create and share the link

  1. Press Copy to clipboard to use the result. Create paste -painiketta.
  2. The service automatically creates a unique link for your paste.
  3. Copy the link and share it, for example, by email, instant message, or in a GitHub issue.

3. Read an existing paste

Open a paste link shared with you in the browser. The text is shown as a readable page. The paste remains on the server for the specified time, after which it is removed automatically.

Privacy

Paste content is stored on the server temporarily until it expires. Content is not encrypted at rest — do not store sensitive data in pastes.
